title: RelayDesk — AI Support Platform
description: Self-hosted help desk combining live chat, ticket management, knowledge base, AI assistance and customer communication. Designed as a Laravel-based product with installation wizard, support widget, automations, reporting, privacy controls and deployment documentation.
features: Self-hosted live chat, support tickets and knowledge base
Embed chat support into customer websites
Assist support teams with AI, handoff and automated workflows
Manage reports, customer records, privacy controls and deployment
workflow: Receive a visitor request through chat or support channels
Search knowledge and offer AI-assisted response
Route unresolved requests to support agents
